mechanism_narrative: A sustained federal funds rate at or below 0.5% indicates an accommodative monetary policy environment that reduces the discount rate for equity valuation, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day returns are negative in more than 40% of instances when FEDFUNDS is at or below 0.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month increase in the unemployment rate exceeding 0.3 percentage points triggers a negative market reaction due to heightened recession concerns, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE rises by >0.3pp over 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: A concurrent decline in industrial production (INDPRO) and payroll employment (PAYEMS) over the past month indicates a weakening economic output and labor market, triggering negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO and PAYEMS decline > 0.5% in 1 month
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when both INDPRO and PAYEMS decline by >0.5% in 1 month.

mechanism_narrative: When the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) exceeds 225, it signals persistent inflation that may prompt the Federal Reserve to tighten monetary policy, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when CPIAUCSL > 225.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly increase in housing starts (HOUST) exceeding 1% indicates robust consumer demand for housing, which typically precedes stronger economic growth and positive equity market returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when HOUST rises by >1% in 1 month.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent monthly growth in retail sales (RSAFS) and housing starts (HOUST) exceeding 0.5% indicates robust consumer demand, which typically drives positive equity market returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: RSAFS and HOUST both rise > 0.5% in 1 month
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of instances when both RSAFS and HOUST rise by >0.5% in 1 month.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly industrial production (INDPRO) level below 90.0 indicates a contraction in manufacturing output, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when INDPRO < 90.0.

mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate at or below 0.5% (FEDFUNDS) indicates an accommodative monetary policy that supports equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day returns are negative in more than 40% of instances when FEDFUNDS <= 0.5%.
